wording.D-CARD-PULSE: PULSE is researching ways to charge electric vehicles and, under agreed conditions, exchange energy with the electricity system. Stationary wireless charging, vehicle-to-grid (V2G) and automated vehicle positioning are separate capabilities. Availability, compatibility, performance and benefits are not guaranteed by this research survey.
wording.D-CARD-W: Stationary wireless charging transfers electricity to a compatible EV while it is parked above compatible equipment. The driver or an authorised positioning system must place the vehicle correctly. It is not charging while driving. Charging speed, compatibility and reliability depend on the installation and operating conditions.
wording.D-CARD-V: V2G lets a compatible EV battery send electricity to the grid through suitable bidirectional equipment. It may help balance electricity demand and supply, depending on how the service operates. Participation depends on an agreement about battery reserve, ready time, control, data and payment. Payments or environmental benefits are not guaranteed. V2G is different from V2H, which supplies a home rather than the grid.
